runa.Desc: Lights up when someone comes close

Editor.PortaDica: The door still opens and closes the normal Foundry way. Here you choose what else happens at each moment.
Editor.ParedeDica: A plain wall only has the "When someone walks through" moment. Tip: a wall that doesn't block movement becomes an invisible tripwire.
Editor.Inicial: How it starts on the map
Editor.MesmaImagem: All looks use the same image. Use "Change image" so the object really changes when used.

Aparencia.Dica: Pick a template. It comes with states, animation and how it's used, and you can change anything.
Aparencia.AnimDica: Each look can have its own image (on the left). Click "Test" to see it.
Aparencia.SomDica: Plays for everyone on this map whenever the object changes its look.

clicar.Desc: The player clicks it on the map

pisar.Desc: Changes when a token stops on it

perto.Desc: Changes when a token comes near, no click

Uso.DistanciaClicar: The player's token must be this close to use it.
Uso.DistanciaPerto: How close a token must get for the object to react.
Uso.MaoDica: Shows the object can be used
Uso.BrilhoDica: A pulsing outline when the player's token is in reach
Uso.MestreDica: You, the GM, use any object with a plain click on the token layer, just like players. To edit, open the Living Objects tool on the left bar and click the object. With it open, clicking a regular tile (for example, an asset placed with FA Nexus) turns it into a living object.

Acoes.Vazio: Nothing happens at this moment yet. Pick an action below.

Regras.ArrasteAtor: Drag an actor from the sidebar here
Regras.Usos: How many times it can be used
Regras.UsosDica: After that the object stops responding. Used {n}x so far.
Regras.Voltar: Goes back to its first look by itself
Regras.VoltarDica: Like a button or a pressure plate
Regras.VoltarTempoDica: After this time the object goes back to how it started
Regras.ConfirmarDica: The GM approves before the actions happen
Regras.TrancadoDica: Nobody can use it until unlocked (by you, another object or a macro)

Opc.inicial: Go back to the first look
Opc.token: The token of whoever used it
Opc.jogadores: All player tokens on the map

AcaoDica.som: Plays once. For long or ambient sounds, use Music.
AcaoDica.portas: On the Walls layer, select the doors on the map and click "Add selected".
AcaoDica.visibilidade: Select tiles, tokens, lights, sounds, notes or drawings on the map and click "Add selected". You can go layer by layer.
AcaoDica.objeto: Example: the lever unlocks the chest, or lights the room's runes.
AcaoDica.chat: You can use {token}, {jogador}, {objeto} and {mapa} in the text.
AcaoDica.imagem: Opens the image in a window for whoever needs to see it.
AcaoDica.diario: If the person can't see the journal, the GM grants observer permission.
AcaoDica.camera: Pans the camera to the object or to a region. Zoom 0 keeps the current zoom.
AcaoDica.escuridao: 0% = bright day, 100% = total darkness. Duration in seconds.
AcaoDica.musica: Uses Foundry's native playlists and plays for the whole table.
AcaoDica.mover: Moves the token (with HP and effects) and the player who owns it, with World Navigator's transition screen.

Campo.TextoExemplo: Something heavy moves in the depths...
Campo.SemObjetos: There are no other living objects on this map.
Campo.AbraOMapa: Open the map "{mapa}" to select things on it.
Campo.SelecionePortas: Select one or more doors on the Walls layer.
Campo.SelecioneObjetos: Select tiles, tokens, lights, sounds, notes or drawings on the map.

Resumo.Configurar: Click Edit to set it up

Secao.NaoETile: This tile is not a living object yet.
Secao.NaoEParede: This wall has no actions yet.
Secao.RemoverPergunta: Remove the living object? Its looks and actions will be lost (the tile or wall stays on the map).

Aviso.SalvePrimeiro: Save the tile or wall first.
Aviso.Longe: You are too far away to use that.
Aviso.SemMestre: A GM must be connected to use objects.
Aviso.ErroAcao: "{objeto}": the "{acao}" action failed. Check the console (F12).
Aviso.SemNavegador: "Move to another map" needs the World Navigator module active.

Bib.MinhaDica: The image becomes an object with depth on the map
Bib.MeusVazio: Objects you build and save with "Save to library" show up here, ready to use on any map.
Bib.Dica: Click an asset to place it in the scene (wheel rotates, Ctrl+wheel resizes) or drag it straight onto the map. The library stays open while you build the scene.
Bib.ApagarPergunta: Remove this object from "My objects"? The ones already on maps stay there.
Bib.SalvarDica: Keeps this object in "My objects" to use on other maps. Doors and objects picked in the actions are left out, since they belong to this map.
Bib.Erro: Something went wrong showing the library. Details are in the console (F12).

Controle.Editar: Click a tile to edit it or make it a living object

Prof.Dica: Makes the object "pop" off the map with shadow, height and tilt. Your changes show on the map right away.
Prof.ParallaxDica: When the camera moves, the object shifts a little, as if it were closer

Encaixe.Dica: click to place · mouse wheel rotates · Ctrl+wheel resizes · Shift ignores the grid · right click or Esc cancels
Encaixe.Teclas: W/S tilt · A/D turn sideways · Q/E rotate · F mirror · R back to top view (with Shift, 5° steps)

Assets.Explica: Pick the folder where you keep your assets (items, furniture, scene props, including ones downloaded from Forgotten Adventures and others). Browse the folders, search by name and click an asset to place it in the scene as a living object.
Assets.Erro: Couldn't open this folder. Pick another one.

DD.Explica: You can also open a Dungeondraft pack (.dungeondraft_pack) directly, no extracting needed.
DD.ErroLer: Couldn't read “{nome}”. Make sure it is a Dungeondraft pack (.dungeondraft_pack).
DD.ErroEnvio: Couldn't send the pack image to Foundry. Check that you are allowed to upload files.
DD.GuardarDica: Copies the pack file into Foundry. In future sessions it shows up in the list and opens with one click, without picking the file again.
DD.Guardado: “{nome}” kept. It will show up in the list in future sessions.

Camaleao.LigarDica: For players, the object becomes invisible: the map looks exactly the same, with no difference at all, but the object keeps working (stepping, clicking, coming close). You still see the object, half transparent.
Camaleao.RevelarDica: When someone uses it (or steps on it), the object is revealed to everyone
Camaleao.Revelado: This object has already been revealed.
Camaleao.VerParar: Stop seeing it as players do
Camaleao.SemProf: While the object is camouflaged, depth, 3D view, the hand cursor and the glow stay off so they don't give it away.

Visao.Dica: Turns the object like a card in space, with perspective, to fit the map's view. The image stays flat: you can tilt and turn it, but the other side of the drawing doesn't appear.
Visao.EspelharDica: Flips the image left to right
